bio.text: Fred Clark, a Democrat, won the August 2026 Democratic primary for Wisconsin's open 7th Congressional District seat, according to the Wisconsin Examiner's primary voter guide, which marks him as the winning candidate.
He represented Baraboo in the Wisconsin State Assembly from 2009 to 2014 and later moved to Bayfield County.

The Examiner reports that he owns Clark Forestry, Inc., has worked as a forestry consultant for the Wisconsin DNR and as a forestry ecologist for the Nature Conservancy, and was executive director and a founding board member of Wisconsin Green Fire.
